snippet.title: Better Than Dead — Announcement Trailer (MicroProse) | Bodycam FPS
snippet.description:
A raw bodycam FPS set in ’90s Hong Kong.
Short, brutal missions. One pistol. Miss and you’re dead.

More info & wishlist on Steam:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2599690/Better_Than_Dead/
